blocks.x: Data & Lakehouse for Health Insurance & Benefits — trusted data at decision speed — pipelines, lakehouse and governance that stand up to audit applied to the health insurance & benefits operating unit of Insurance & Risk.

Health payers sit between clinical reality and administrative machinery: prior authorization, coding integrity, quality programs and member experience all hinge on reading clinical evidence quickly and acting on it consistently — at HIPAA-grade privacy.

items: Claims codes and clinical narratives never reconcile; coding integrity and HEDIS-style quality reporting both suffer.
Requests bounce for missing clinical evidence that exists in notes; turn-around times breach SLAs and clinicians revolt.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization, Data Engineering & Pipeline Modernization, Enterprise BI & Executive Analytics from the Data, Analytics & Lakehouse tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Prior authorization, Claims coding integrity, Quality/HEDIS reporting) on Achala Forge and Achala Nexus. Governance inherits the sector frame — HIPAA among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Lakehouse the right way — Unity Catalog governance, cost-aware design and AI-ready foundations.
Decisions at event speed — sub-second pipelines from sensor, click or transaction to action.
Metrics into management — one governed semantic layer, decision cadence built in.
codes + narratives unified for coding integrity and quality reporting (audit evidence complete)
